cover: Global political shakeups, Middle East strikes, and major European unrest mark the day
cover_scene: A split composition showing dramatic global events, including a political hall in South America, airstrikes over a European city, and a warship navigating waters in the Middle East under heavy clouds

slides.scene: A presidential office in Asuncion with a Paraguayan flag behind a vacant desk as security officers stand outside in bright daylight
slides.headline: Paraguay President Peña Ousted and Arrested
slides.body: Paraguay's Senate impeached and ousted President Santiago Peña following the sudden collapse of a national bank. Vice President Pedro Alliana was rapidly sworn in as head of state while Peña was placed under arrest.

slides.scene: Coastal highlands looking down on the Bab al-Mandeb Strait, with small military outposts overlooking passing cargo ships under a hazy sky
slides.headline: Yemeni Forces Seize Heights Near Strategic Strait
slides.body: Yemeni armed forces captured strategic heights overlooking the Bab al-Mandeb Strait from Saudi-backed troops. The advance places key maritime trade routes under direct observation amid intensifying regional strikes and ongoing conflict.

slides.scene: Firefighters in Kyiv working at night to extinguish flames at a damaged power facility, emergency lights glowing through smoke
slides.headline: Russian Airstrikes Hit Kyiv Ahead of Talks
slides.body: Russia launched a wave of airstrikes targeting Kyiv's power infrastructure, causing blackouts and water shortages. Emergency crews responded to damaged sites across the capital as Ukraine prepares for upcoming trilateral diplomatic talks.

slides.scene: A polling station in Wellington with election workers processing ballot boxes under bright indoor lights during a tense vote tally
slides.headline: New Zealand Election Ends Without Clear Majority
slides.body: Preliminary results from New Zealand's general election showed no political party securing a clear parliamentary majority. The tight race leaves the country facing weeks of coalition negotiations to form a functioning government.
